name: medqa_s3_v1_r1_strict_early
responses: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.
I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.
I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse.
